title: Integrability in Asymptotic Symmetries of Spacetime: the $\text{BMS}_3$ scenario
summary: We discuss the existence of a well-defined $\mathfrak{bms}_3$-integrable hierarchy, introduced in Fuentealba et al. (JHEP, 2018), using different structural methodologies. Specifically, from the variational complex on the ring of polynomial symbols, a $\mathfrak{bms}_3$ bi-Hamiltonian structure is constructed on which a Nijenhuis operator can be attached. A similar argument is made for the $\mathrm{AdS}_3$ case, where we check that the flat limit of the latter recovers the asymptotically flat situation.
